pages.text: There are a few ways to obtain spirits that you won't see in JEI. Nether portals (the purple portal blocks, not the obsidian) yield Nether spirits. Fire blocks yield fire spirits. Water source blocks yield water spirits. If a block influence of a time hallow would be randomly ticked, it will yield nine time spirits instead.

There's also a special way to get War spirits: every point of damage dealt by a hallowed weapon will put a War spirit in that weapon. With some clever setup and a $(l:otherverse:items/spawn_altar)spawn altar$(), this can make for a self-contained mob farm.$(br2)Shield hallows will also convert blocked damage into Protection spirits.

If you're using diagrams to smelt an item, they will only smelt the item by one step (i.e. cobblestone into stone, but not into smooth stone) $(italic)unless$() the target item is also influenced by a furnace.
